clue.text: Stake tents I severed clumsily close to midnight
Meat eaten by native Alaskans
Absolutely sneaky ruse
Embarrassingly, pee is… um… hm… "number one," for instance
It pains, ultimately, inside!
Synergy of exotic worm in Asian tree
Dance held in humdrum ballroom
Fan of children's vehicle in Dixie, for the most part
Manipulate poor sap on that point
Largely respect Alabama officer
Cruelly hurt lean Christian
Holler, "That hurts, knave!"—and in France, it can sting
Real estate tycoon adopts one high school and succeeds
Pull away from company taken in by counterfeit lire
Bug Spooner's geology tutor
Artless cut in start of film (American Beauty, for example) — that's sweet
Singer to pursue dissonant tune internally
Daddy running around nude — I crumbled and paid
Rare and grammatically proper?
That's nice — streetcar returning in Washington
Negotiate with witch over broken leg
Inverted snapshot I catch with members of an army (those who have enlisted)
Picture one thousand years
Coming back within, mutter words of reproach
Fabric riding up can lack finish
Oscar, perhaps, following Seine's banks downriver
Time and time again, breaking something that binds a pig
Mixing it, use the recipe for an item found in the completed grid
